question: Which of the following book is the autobiography of Dalai Lama?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Freedom in Exile.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Freedom in Exile** is the **autobiography of Dalai Lama.**
 
• 
 
**Tenzin Gyatso**, the **14th Dalai Lama**, identifies as a straightforward Buddhist monk.

 
 
• 
 
He is Tibet's spiritual head. He was born in Taktser, Amdo, northern Tibet, on July 6, 1935, into a farming family in a tiny village.

 
 
• 
 
The **infant**, then **known as Lhamo Dhondup**, was acknowledged as the **13th Dalai Lama Thubten Gyatso**'s reincarnation when he was two years old.

 
 
• 
 
**The Dalai Lamas** are thought to be embodiments of Tibet's patron saint, **Avalokiteshvara**, also known as **Chenrezig**, the **Bodhisattva of Compassion**.

 
 
• 
 
Aspired to become Buddhas for the good of all sentient beings, bodhisattvas are realized beings who have promised to reincarnate in the world to aid humanity.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Touch Play** is the autobiography of **Prakash Padukone**. 

 
 
• This is the first book on and is possibly only the second biography of any badminton player.
 
• The second edition has a foreword by Morten Frost, the four-time All England winner and close friend of Padukone.
 
 
 
• **Playing It My Way **is the autobiography of former Indian **cricketer Sachin Tendulkar**.
 
 
• It was launched on 5 November 2014 in Mumbai.
 
 
 
• **The Red Sari (El sari rojo)**, which is a dramatized biography of the life of **Sonia Gandhi,** originally **written in Spanish by Javier Moro** and published in October 2008 in Spain.
